cases.sentence: На небе появилось поразительное знамение. ___, одетая в солнце.
cases.translation: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun.
cases.explain: Женщина is the subject of the sentence, requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Огромный красный ___ с семью головами и десятью рогами.
cases.translation: A great red dragon with seven heads and ten horns.
cases.explain: Дракон is the subject of the predicate nominative, taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Его хвост упал с небес на ___.
cases.translation: His tail fell from the sky to the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition на with direction takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: She gave birth to a son, a male child.
cases.explain: The direct object of родила (gave birth to) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: И ребенок был взят к Богу и его ___.
cases.translation: The child was caught up to God and to his throne.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) always takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: А ___ убежала в пустыню в место, приготовленное для нее Богом.
cases.translation: The woman fled into the wilderness to a place prepared by God.
cases.explain: Женщина is the subject of убежала (fled), requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: На небе началась ___. На одной стороне сражались Михаил и его ангелы.
cases.translation: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war.
cases.explain: Война is the subject of the predicate началась (began), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Этот великий ___, древний змей, был сброшен на землю.
cases.translation: The great dragon, the old serpent, was thrown down to the earth.
cases.explain: Дракон is an appositive to the subject, requiring the nominative case.

reading.ru: На небе появилось поразительное знамение. Женщина, одетая в солнце, у которой под ногами была луна, а на голове венец из 12 звезд.
reading.question: What sign appeared in heaven?
options: A woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head
A red dragon with seven heads and ten horns
An angel descending from heaven with a scroll
A great light splitting the sky into four parts
reading.correct: A woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head
reading.explain: The text describes 'Женщина, одетая в солнце, у которой под ногами была луна, а на голове венец из 12 звезд' — a woman clothed with the sun, moon under her feet, and crown of stars.

reading.ru: Потом на небе появилось другое знамение. Огромный красный дракон с семью головами, десятью рогами и семью венцами на головах.
reading.question: What did the second sign in heaven show?
options: A great red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven crowns on his heads
A book sealed with seven seals
Four horsemen riding across the sky
reading.correct: A great red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven crowns on his heads
reading.explain: The text states 'Огромный красный дракон с семью головами, десятью рогами и семью венцами на головах' — a great red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven crowns.

reading.ru: Женщина родила сына, младенца мужского пола, которому предстоит править всеми народами железным скипетром.
reading.question: What kind of child did the woman give birth to?
options: A son, a male child, who would rule all nations with a rod of iron
A girl child who would become a prophet
A child who would serve as a priest
A child who would lead a kingdom of peace
reading.correct: A son, a male child, who would rule all nations with a rod of iron
reading.explain: The text says 'Женщина родила сына, младенца мужского пола, которому предстоит править всеми народами железным скипетром' — she bore a son who would rule all nations with an iron rod.

reading.ru: На небе началась война. На одной стороне сражались Михаил и его ангелы, а на другой стороне воевал дракон со своими ангелами.
reading.question: What war started in heaven and who fought in it?
options: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon and his angels
Satan and his demons fought against the archangels
The saints fought against the powers of darkness
Angels and men fought against the spirits of evil
reading.correct: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon and his angels
reading.explain: The text states 'На одной стороне сражались Михаил и его ангелы, а на другой стороне воевал дракон' — Michael and his angels fought against the dragon.

reading.ru: Этот великий дракон, древний змей, которого называют дьяволом и сатаной, он, обольщающий весь мир, был вместе со своими ангелами сброшен на землю.
reading.question: What happened to the great dragon and his angels?
options: They were thrown down to the earth
They were locked in the abyss
reading.correct: They were thrown down to the earth
reading.explain: The text says 'был вместе со своими ангелами сброшен на землю' — he and his angels were thrown down to the earth.

reading.ru: Когда дракон увидел, что он сброшен на землю, то стал преследовать женщину, родившую мальчика.
reading.question: What did the dragon do when he was cast down to the earth?
options: He persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child
He tried to destroy the throne of God
He gathered his demons for battle
He fled to hide in the abyss
reading.correct: He persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child
reading.explain: The text states 'стал преследовать женщину, родившую мальчика' — he persecuted the woman who had borne the male child.
